title: Unused imports in the owned route file will fail the configured Ruff lint step

evidence.quote: from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

reasoning: func and LLMService are imported but unused in app/api/health.py. The project lint command is Ruff with Pyflakes rules enabled, so these are F401 failures and can block CI or release checks even though the route tests pass.
reproduction: Run the project lint command, hatch run ruff check ., in an environment with hatch available; Ruff reports unused-import diagnostics for these imports.
recommendation: Remove unused imports, or use LLMService as part of the health response if the endpoint should report AI provider health.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise HTTP behavior only; they do not run the lint command and cannot catch unused-import build failures.
